title: Law to create resident parking permits in East Elmhurst
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to set up a residential parking permit system in East Elmhurst, Queens. The system would designate permit areas and times, reserve at least 20% of spaces for non-residents with short-term parking of at least 90 minutes, and exempt certain vehicles. It would not apply on streets zoned for commercial, office or retail use, and would take effect 120 days after becoming law.
